changeSet.author: vasileios.vitzilaios@keyes.eu
changeSet.comment: Populate permitNotificationType (and otherFactorReportingType for OTHER_FACTOR) in metadata for existing PERMIT_NOTIFICATION requests
changeSet.sql: UPDATE request r SET metadata = COALESCE(r.metadata, jsonb_build_object('type', 'PERMIT_NOTIFICATION')) || jsonb_build_object('permitNotificationType', r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type') || CASE WHEN r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' = 'OTHER_FACTOR' AND r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'reportingType' IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('otherFactorReportingType', r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'reportingType') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END WHERE r.type = 'PERMIT_NOTIFICATION' AND r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' IS NOT NULL;

rollback.sql: UPDATE request r SET metadata = r.metadata - 'permitNotificationType' - 'otherFactorReportingType' WHERE r.type = 'PERMIT_NOTIFICATION' AND r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' IS NOT NULL;

changeSet.author: vasileios.vitzilaios@keyes.eu
changeSet.comment: Remove permitNotificationType from OTHER_FACTOR notification metadata as otherFactorReportingType is the specific value to display
changeSet.sql: UPDATE request r SET metadata = r.metadata - 'permitNotificationType' WHERE r.type = 'PERMIT_NOTIFICATION' AND r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' = 'OTHER_FACTOR';

rollback.sql: UPDATE request r SET metadata = r.metadata || jsonb_build_object('permitNotificationType', 'OTHER_FACTOR') WHERE r.type = 'PERMIT_NOTIFICATION' AND r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' = 'OTHER_FACTOR';

changeSet.author: vasileios.vitzilaios@keyes.eu
changeSet.comment: Populate permit notification type metadata from request_action for requests with null payload; picks the newest valid action; skips in-progress.
changeSet.sql: WITH latest_valid_action AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (ra.request_id) ra.request_id, ra.payload FROM request_action ra WHERE ra.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ra.request_id, ra.creation_date DESC ) UPDATE request r SET metadata = COALESCE(r.metadata, jsonb_build_object('type', 'PERMIT_NOTIFICATION')) || CASE WHEN lva.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' != 'OTHER_FACTOR' THEN jsonb_build_object('permitNotificationType', lva.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END || CASE WHEN lva.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' = 'OTHER_FACTOR' THEN jsonb_build_object('otherFactorReportingType', lva.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'reportingType') ELSE '{}'::jsonb END FROM latest_valid_action lva WHERE r.id = lva.request_id AND r.type = 'PERMIT_NOTIFICATION' AND (r.payload IS NULL OR r.payload -> 'permitNotification' ->> 'type' IS NULL) AND r.metadata -> 'permitNotificationType' IS NULL AND r.metadata -> 'otherFactorReportingType' IS NULL;
